title: Drake Drops ‘Iceman’ Merch on His Amazon ‘Warehouse’: Shop the Collection Online Here
summary: The Canadian rapper has updated his official Amazon "Warehouse" shop with new merch and apparel, including exclusives.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Drake expanded his latest musical era on May 15, with the release of three projects: Iceman , Habibti and Maid of Honour . While Iceman serves as the centerpiece of the rollout, the companion albums explore different sonic and thematic directions, giving fans three distinct listening experiences that dropped on the same day.

The rapper also released a collection of merchandise to accompany his ambitious music launch, turning to his Amazon ‘warehouse’ as the home for the exclusive merch.

Shop Drake Merch & Apparel On Amazon

The Amazon storefront has become a recurring part of Drake’s promotional strategy since it debuted in August 2025. Drake’s “Warehouse” has featured multiple collections inspired by his music, including a ‘Gimme a Hug’ Valentine’s Day t-shirt , a ‘Nokia Cellphone’ poster and other collectibles like pillows, boy bonnets, magnets and even a hilarious (and slightly creepy) Drake face mask. Not to mention his line of perfumes available online at Ulta Beauty . 

The latest products at Drake’s Amazon Warehouse center on Iceman , alongside pieces inspired by Habibti and Maid of Honour .

AMAZON EXCLUSIVE

Record Holder T-Shirt

$55

Buy Now on Amazon

The front of this tee features the Iceman cover artwork, while the back displays a large photorealistic glove incorporating Drake’s signature. 

This is a heavyweight, black short-sleeve tee made from 100% cotton and manufactured in the United States. The Amazon-exclusive shirt has a pullover design, is machine washable and is available in sizes S through 3XL. 

100% COTTON FLEECE

Freeze the World Hoodie

$190

Made from heavyweight 100% cotton fleece, this machine-washable hoodie is available in sizes S-3XL.

The official “Freeze the World” hoodie comes in blue with a classic pullover and a kangaroo pocket. The standout design of the hoodie appears on the back and sleeves, where oversized “Freeze the World” artwork is screen-printed. 

SIZES S–3XL

Ice Lebanese Long Sleeve T-Shirt

$95

Part of the United with Lebanon collection, the Ice Lebanese long sleeve t-shirt combines Drake’s philanthropy with his Iceman album promotion.

The “Ice Lebanese” long sleeve t-shirt is a heavyweight white cotton crew neck featuring oversized “Iceman” branding across the front, blue flames on the front and down the sleeves and “Red Lebanese” on the back. Released by Drake’s OVO in 2020, as part of the United with Lebanon clothing line, the merch supports the Lebanese Red Cross after the Beirut port explosion, with all proceeds benefiting relief efforts. The long-sleeve t-shirt is available in sizes S–3XL.

'Where She At' T-Shirt

This black heavyweight cotton t-shirt features graphics on the front and Drake’s viral lyrics from Burning Bridges on the back.

Drake puts his iconic Where She At? lyrics on the back of this black tee in a question mark shape and line-work faces in puff-print on the front. This Amazon-exclusive shirt is machine washable and comes in sizes S-3XL. 

MACHINE WASHABLE

Gervin Jersey T-Shirt

$60

Inspired by Basketball Hall of Fame athlete George “The Iceman” Gervin, the official Gervin jersey t-shirt adopts the look of a vintage sports jersey. 

Inspired by Drake’s signed jersey from George Gervin , this t-shirt is available in sizes S-3XL. The white heavyweight cotton shirt features “44” on the front, while the back includes “Iceman” lettering above an oversized “44” and an “Iceman” signature written over the number.

MADE IN THE USA

ICEMAN x Affliction T-Shirt

The official Iceman x Affliction t-shirt marks a collaboration between Drake and edgy apparel brand Affliction. 

The heavyweight, 100% cotton graphic tee features a blue tie-dye finish with screen-printed “Iceman” and Affliction artwork on the front. On the chest is a skull with large wings extending behind it. The shirt is available in sizes S-3XL.

CREW NECK

ICEMAN x Affliction Long Sleeve T-Shirt

Drake and Affliction teamed up to bring gothic vibes to the rapper’s album promotion. The front of this long-sleeve tee features a skeleton, two skulls and detailed line-drawn artwork, while several skulls are printed on the back.

The long-sleeve counterpart to the Iceman x Affliction collaboration features a heavyweight, white cotton long-sleeve t-shirt with a crew neckline. Like the rest of the collection, it’s available in sizes S-3XL.

ZIPPER

National Treasure Zip Hoodie

The official National Treasure zip hoodie is a nod to Drake’s “National Treasures” track on the Iceman album . The jacket features a vintage black finish with a full-zip closure and is made of heavyweight cotton fleece.

Drake continues the narrative of being a national treasure in his native Toronto, with this official National Treasure zip hoodie. The front features a 3D-style “National Treasure” artwork designed to resemble embroidered stitching through a simulated print technique, while the back remains blank. The hoodie is available in sizes S-3XL.

ADJUSTIBLE

3 for 3 Cap

Drake’s 3 for 3 Cap highlights all three records in his 2026 album rollout — Iceman , Habibti and Maid of Honour .

This camo baseball cap features an embroidered “Snow Owl” logo on the front, while the side and rear panels include embroidered references to all three albums. It’s made from 100% cotton twill with an adjustable strap for a one-size fit. The cap is assembled in the USA with imported materials, with hand-wash care instructions.

Habibti T-Shirt

This Amazon-exclusive is the only shirt dedicated to Habibti in Drake’s recent merch line.

Representing Drake’s companion album Habibti , this off-white heavyweight cotton T-shirt features oversized puff-printed “Habibti” across the front and a pair of eyes at the back.

PULLOVER

Maid of Honour Long Sleeve T-Shirt

The white Maid of Honour long sleeve t-shirt comes with cursive writing in blue along the front and blue floral artwork across the back.

In sizes S-3XL, the official Maid of Honour long sleeve t-Shirt is made from heavyweight white 100% cotton. The Drake merch features “Maid of Honour” script across the front of the tee and along the sleeves. The back is finished with an embroidered heart in blue floral detailing. 

Air Drake Silk Robe

$220

Dress for bed as Drake does. This Amazon-exclusive Air Drake Robe is crafted from 100% silk for a premium feel.

Drake’s silk robe features the “Air Drake” logo embroidered on the left chest and is designed in a one-size-fits-most unisex size. Dry clean only to preserve its luxurious finish.

100% POLYESTER

Drake Car Windshield Sun Shade

Passersby will do a double-take with this hilarious Drake windshield sun shade, featuring a photorealistic image of Drake smoldering behind the steering wheel.

Measuring 25 x 50 inches, the collapsible polyester shade blocks 100% of UV rays with a satin silver backing, while helping keep your car’s interior cooler. Easy to open, fold and store with the included elastic strap.

ALUMINUM

More Life Metallic Blue Birthday Balloons

$20

Drake’s easy-to-assemble metallic blue “More Life” balloons are inspired by the rapper’s iconic 2017 playlist.

This eight-piece foil balloon set includes a straw for easy air inflation plus adhesive dots for simple wall display. Made from durable aluminum foil with built-in hanging tabs, these balloons create a standout party backdro…
